blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: memory read — Retrieve contents of addressed location.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Address bus identifies the location the processor wants to access; typically the CPU drives address lines on a simple memory read.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Data bus transfers the contents between memory and processor; for ordinary memory reads the bits travel memory-to-CPU.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Control bus signals operation and coordination, including read/write; distinguish purpose and direction rather than treating all buses as one road.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the mechanism
blocks.text: Address bus12; control bus READ; data bus returns99, placed in MDR. Address12 and content99 are different types of information.

blocks.title: Explain the mechanism
blocks.text: Address bus44, data bus25 from CPU to memory, control bus WRITE. On writing, data flows towards memory while address still identifies destination.
